 Health Canada Warns Foreign Matter Found in Some Types of PegLyte
 St. John's, NL, Canada / VOCM 
 Beth Fagan --> 
 Nov 18, 2026 | 10:44 AM 
 A product which is used by people as a pre-diagnostic step has been singled out by Health Canada. 
 Pendopharm brand PegLyte powder , which is sold in pharmacies and taken by patients prior to some medical scans, may contain foreign matter. Health Canada says users should consult with their provider before deciding to discontinue use of PegLyte.
